name: 1-PP
summary: 1-(2-Pyrimidinyl)piperazine (1-PP, 1-PmP) is a chemical compound and piperazine derivative.3–40 nM) and, to a much lesser extent, as a partial agonist of the 5-HT1A receptor (Ki = 414 nM; Emax = 54%). It has negligible affinity for the dopamine D2, D3, and D4 receptors (Ki > 10,000 nM) and does not appear to have significant affinity for the α1-adrenergic receptors. Its crystal structure has been determined.

pharmacology.text: It is known to act as an antagonist of the α2-adrenergic receptor (Ki = 7.3–40 nM) and, to a much lesser extent, as a partial agonist of the 5-HT1A receptor (Ki = 414 nM; Emax = 54%).

summaryZh: 1-(2-嘧啶基)哌嗪（英語：1-piperazine，縮寫1-PP或1-PmP）是一種有機化合物，分子式C8H12N4，屬於哌嗪衍生物，可用作α2腎上腺素受體的受體拮抗劑。
summaryZhHans: 1-(2-嘧啶基)哌嗪（英语：1-piperazine，缩写1-PP或1-PmP）是一种有机化合物，分子式C8H12N4，属于哌嗪衍生物，可用作α2肾上腺素受体的受体拮抗剂。

uses.en: It is mainly met as a metabolite of buspirone and similar drugs, and is used in research.
uses.zh: 它主要以丁螺環酮及類似藥物的代謝物形式出現，也用於研究。
uses.zhHans: 它主要以丁螺环酮及类似药物的代谢物形式出现，也用于研究。

fact.en: It is the main breakdown product of the anti-anxiety drug buspirone and its relatives, so people taking buspirone carry it in their blood.
fact.zh: 它是抗焦慮藥丁螺環酮（buspirone）及其相關藥物的主要代謝產物，所以服用丁螺環酮的人血液中都會有它。
fact.zhHans: 它是抗焦虑药丁螺环酮（buspirone）及其相关药物的主要代谢产物，所以服用丁螺环酮的人血液中都会有它。
